_description: Inside the data center, as a grid of letters (same format as maps/valley.json; see its _description). Inside tile kinds: floor (raised floor), vent (cold-aisle vented floor), cables (floor with cable runs), wall, exit-door (in a wall), server-rack, gpu-rack, ups-cabinet (battery), power-cabinet, storage-shelf (each 1 wide × 2 tall, most with blinking lights), cooling-unit, water-tank, transformer (2 × 2), workstation (workers stop at these), server-cart, crates, extinguisher (1 × 1). 'doors' leads back out to the valley. 'npcs' with role "worker" are data center scientists in lab coats (looks 0–5: 0 and 3 are men; 1, 2, 4 and 5 are women). Each hotspot covers its whole piece of equipment ('area'), which glows when Alex is near. 'noise' fixes the noise meter and hum in here: 'level' 1 = meter maxed, 'volume' = how loud the hum is (above 1 = really loud).
